notes.title: Country Road VR LATEST VERSION is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Elder's Choice and Somun Immersive are please to introduce the official updated release of Country Road VR. The newest version of the popular Virtual Petting Farm is bigger and brighter than ever before. Here are some of the latest updates:

*Ability to pick fruits and vegetables, and feed them to the animals

*Fruit trees

*Expanded sunflower fields with exciting TROPHY ITEMS scattered about

*New animals animations and reactions

*Baskets for placing food items in and carrying them back to the farm

*Many other surprises such as "minimized gravity" which allows items you throw to go amazingly far!

*A new open world environment allowing you to get creative and even a little humorous as you spend time on the farm.

We of course still hold true to our traditional petting farm and with these new features, Country Road VR is now FUN FOR ALL AGES! We hope you enjoy this calm, serene, magical, and fun experience. Please feel free to take screenshots and videos. We'd love to see your own creativity!

***Previously purchased versions should update upon re-launching of Country Road VR***

notes.title: Bigger Farm area, Fruit Trees, and Trophy Items Are Coming!
notes.content:
Country Road VR is about to get yet another major update! The Farm has been expanded to include fruit trees such as apples, pears, and more! In addition, there are vegetables such as carrots and cabbage. All of these food items may be placed in a basket or carried one by one back to the petting farm and actually fed to the animals. 

In addition, a variety of special "trophy" items are scattered about in the sunflower fields. Look for pitchforks, golden apples, golden carrots, and even donuts -- and of course so much more! There's plenty more to do on Country Road VR than simply petting the animals. You'll have so much fun interacting with the animals. We hope you'll enjoy the real-life nature sounds and the calming ambience. 

Escape from your reality and enter Country Road VR. Look for official announcement in addition to more video and screenshot of the new and improved farm! Coming very soon to a VR headset on you!

notes.title: Country Road VR Is NOW PLAYING in VR Arcades!
notes.content:
We are excited to finally announce the official release of Country Road VR - The Virtual Petting Farm for all ages now Live and Available for play at VR Junkies, an exclusive and elaborate VR Arcade located in Arizona, Utah, New Mexico, and North Carolina. 

Although Country Road VR was originally developed to help treat individuals with dementia, our game as also become popular with individuals of all ages, especially kids! Our easy to use, relaxed and serene VR experience is designed to ease the mind through open world exploration.

We will soon be working on some other exciting updates and letting our viewers and the public know the minute they are available. 

For now, you can purchase Country Road VR for only $2.99 at https://store.steampowered.com/app/1188140/Country_Road_VR/


[u]BUY, PLAY, AND GIVE ALL AT THE SAME TIME![/u]

[b]20% of our net proceeds goes towards Alzheimer's Research! [/b]

notes.title: Country Road VR Soon To Be Available At VR Arcades!
notes.content:
Elder's Choice, Inc. and Somun Immersive just signed a deal with VR Junkies to have Country Road VR featured in their VR Arcades. According to VR Junkies, their decision to hand pick the virtual petting farm was due to its ability to provide a more diverse choice of games for their customers. It's been mentioned by VRJ that customers are looking for simple "experiences" in VR in addition to conventional games. 

Michael Bilger, President and CEO of Elder's Choice, Inc. made the announcement today: "We're excited to see an increased level of interest in Country Road VR and this move is telling us as well as the public that VR has a future in many facets of our community." Bilger went on to state that Country Road VR was originally designed to help treat individuals with dementia, yet is really suitable for any age and those who wish for a relaxing, immersive experience. "We hope this drives a more diverse age group into the field of VR and certainly into the VR Arcades of VR Junkies."

Elder's Choice, Inc. has also announced that there is currently discussion on further updates and enhancements planned in the near future to make the experience even more interactive.

Country Road VR is currently available for only $2.99 on the Steam store.

notes.title: Country Road VR is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Our virtual petting farm will feature a number of animals including a horse, cows, chickens, sheep, farm dog, pigs and few other surprises. A floating butterfly will also dazzle your senses as several of them will fly in your line of sight!

Come join the farm and experience realism with vibrating controllers and authentic animals sounds upon petting the animals (compatible VR headset required).

The true inspiration behind this VR experience is for dementia treatment. This VR farm is suitable for use with indiviudals suffering from dementia and other similar diagnosis. It engages sensory stimulation and the benefits of reminiscing.
